turns.assessment: The simultaneous loss of many unprotected services and protection switching of many SNCP services is exactly bounded by their common dependency on the S15 OTN switch. O107 directly reports OTN_FABRIC_FAIL at that switch at the same time, while extensive optical power, OSNR, BER, amplifier, and line-interface telemetry remained unchanged. This strongly identifies an OTN switch-fabric failure rather than a ROADM or line-system fault.

proposals.rationale: E1 is the common S15 OTN switch used by every affected working path. Its explicit fabric-failure alarm coincides with all client failures and protection activations, and an OTN_SWITCH_FAIL interrupts every ODU cross-connected through it without requiring any optical telemetry change.
